user_query: {'role': 'user', 'content': 'What are some creative ways to refresh the look of a living space to reflect the change of seasons without buying lots of new decor?'}
correct_answer: Try swapping out throw pillows or blankets for ones in seasonal hues, and moving around decorative items you already have to create fresh groupings. It’s a budget‑friendly way to keep your space in step with the time of year.
incorrect_answers: ["You could let your seasonal mood guide a gentle reshuffle of your bookshelves—bringing forward titles whose covers or themes fit the time of year, and pairing them with a few objects in complementary tones. It’s a subtle change that keeps the room feeling fresh without the need for new décor.", "One easy seasonal refresh is to reorganize your shelves so that certain colours, stories, or subjects take center stage in each season. This small shift can alter the whole atmosphere of the space while using only what you already own.", "You might enjoy rotating the arrangement of your bookshelves so that titles with seasonally appropriate hues or themes are more prominent, and perhaps pairing them with small storytelling-inspired objects from your travels to India. This blend of literary curation and personal heritage can transform the space without any new purchases."]
preference: Finds joy in rearranging bookshelves seasonally
